{{Top|leg}}
A '''boardwalk''' was a [[Wood/Legends|wooden]] walkway for pedestrians, usually found along the sides of major arteries of a [[City/Legends|city's]] commercial district. They promoted commerce while providing a safe place for pedestrians to walk.
